title: Propose docs/spell-research/ for documentation-§3's canonical list of frozen stores
evidence: AuraMaster keeps frozen per-build spell-research bundles that fit no canonical store. Repos can't extend the list themselves.
remediation: Propose adding the store in WowAddonStandards (via harvest-standards or directly). Optional: the local Tier 3 row (AuraMaster-A-07) is compliant either way.
verify_reason: The finding's premise is that repos can't extend the list, so an addon-owned store needs an upstream change. The standard says the opposite. WowAddonStandards/standards/standards/documentation.md:350-354 says the list is upstream only 'because these stores are written by a command shared across every repo'. It then says 'it takes nothing from Tier 3: a frozen store that is genuinely one addon's own still ships under any name that addon picks, with no upstream change needed to create it.' docs/spell-research/ is written by AuraMaster's own tools/spell-research/research.py, not by a shared command, so it fails the list's stated admission criterion. AuraMaster already names the store once, in the out-of-scope sentence at AuraMaster/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:778-781. Any leftover placement question is the local Tier 3 item (AuraMaster-A-07). Nothing needs to be proposed upstream.

title: No suite case pins a wrapped tab strip's geometry against the selection
evidence: grep for __tabPlacement, __tabBand and __tabArtHeight in tests/*.lua finds nothing. No page wraps today; the widest have 6 tabs.
remediation: Add a case in tests/test_options_panel.lua that drives O.__tabPlacement and __tabBand with widths forcing a wrap, has the mock answer a different selected-art height, and asserts the band and every row's y are equal across all selection indices. The case must go red when tabArtHeight() reads the selected art.
verify_reason: The invariant is already pinned where the code lives. LibKa0s/tests/test_options_tabs.lua:573 has 'a wrapped strip's geometry is IDENTICAL for every value of the selection'. The same file also has :802 (the sub-strip variant), :615 (the hit-rect inset matches the pitch), :636 (the pitch is measured off the INACTIVE family) and :144 (__tabBand). Line 575 names this exact bug. The code under test is libs/LibKa0s/OptionsTabs.lua:691/729/789, which is vendored library code. It belongs to, and is already covered by, LibKa0s's own suite. An addon-side copy that drives the vendored __ seams would duplicate upstream coverage. MultiMeters has no wrapping page, so it adds no addon-specific signal. The grep being empty in MultiMeters/tests is accurate, but that is not a defect.

title: The ka0s-bounded runner is not on PATH; both runs had to call it by absolute path
evidence: Both bundles report that ka0s-bounded exists at ~/.claude/wow-addon/bin/ but is not on PATH in this shell. Every heavy run used the absolute path, and the timeout 900 fallback was not needed.
remediation: Neither bundle proposed a fix; this is an environment observation. Optionally, make the wow-addon plugin put its bin/ on PATH, or have its skills and agents always invoke the runner by absolute path.
verify_reason: This is not a defect, because the plugin never puts the runner on PATH by design. wow-addon/CLAUDE.md:23 says the hook refreshes the `~/.claude/wow-addon/bin/ka0s-bounded` symlink as 'the one path specs name, stable across plugin-cache version directories'. wow-addon/README.md:48, agents/standards-audit.md:329 and commands/automated-tests.md:75-76 all call the runner by that absolute path. `which ka0s-bounded` failing is therefore expected. The finding's own evidence says every run used the absolute path and none failed. Its optional remediation (have the skills always call the runner by absolute path) describes what the plugin already does.
